ball.q: In 2019 Hakan Şükür, Galatasaray's goal machine, revealed he was making a living in the United States how?
ball.sub: He was also selling books, after closing his cafe.

ball.q: Hakan Şükür's first wedding was shown live on television. Which future Turkish president performed it?
ball.a: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, then mayor of Istanbul
ball.sub: The couple divorced four months later.

ball.q: Franck Ribéry walked out on Galatasaray in 2005, unpaid. He also said an agent and a club director had threatened him with what?
ball.sub: FIFA and then CAS ruled in his favour.

ball.q: In 2018 Arda Turan broke a pop singer's nose. What did he then do at the hospital?
ball.a: Fired a gun into the floor
ball.sub: He got a suspended sentence of two years and eight months.

ball.q: Why was the 2018 Turkish Cup semi-final between Fenerbahçe and Beşiktaş abandoned?
ball.a: Beşiktaş boss Şenol Güneş was hit on the head by an object from the crowd
ball.sub: Beşiktaş refused to come back out, so Fenerbahçe went through.

ball.q: How many players did Elazığspor sign in a single day in January 2019, once a transfer ban was lifted?
ball.sub: It earned them a place in the Guinness Book of Records.

ball.q: Which club, in the Süper Lig in 2017-18, kept sliding down the leagues and could not even field a team by October 2022?
Galatasaray beat Fenerbahçe 7-0 in 1911 despite starting with how many players, after a storm kept the rest from crossing the Bosphorus?
The May 2007 derby at Ali Sami Yen is called the Watery Derby. Why?
ball.a: Galatasaray fans threw thousands of plastic water bottles

ball.q: A 2025 audit found 371 of Turkey's 571 professional referees had what?
ball.sub: 152 of them had actually placed bets, and one had placed 18,227.
